Manifest.Name: 原版枪械拓展 Vanilla Gun Expansion
Manifest.Author: KlN
Manifest.Description: 把枪械师的生意补成一条从金属锭到成品枪的制造线，全部建立在原版的枪、配件、弹药和机器上。新物品：四种原版枪的框架芯片、电击枪与泰瑟芯片、17 种配件芯片、6 种弹药芯片（蓝＝武器、紫＝配件、黄铜＝弹药）；火药、高级火药、弹药压制模组、9 个枪位的枪柜（六种外观）、芯片库扩建套件、奥丁的上手说明书。3D 打印机：芯片栏里的芯片库（◀ ▶ 轮换）；框架显示纯度品质，成品枪按打印品质计价；原版配方改用金属锭（设置项，默认关）。王尔德「枪械匠」卡：革命军枪匠、自动供料、自动入库。剧情小分支「隐秘行动」。卸载或停用前：清空芯片库与枪柜；开过金属锭配方的话先关掉，读档后再存一次档。 / Turns the gunsmith trade into a production line from metal ingots to finished guns, built entirely on the vanilla guns, attachments, ammo and machines. New items: frame chips for the four vanilla guns, stun gun and tazer chips, 17 attachment chips and 6 ammo chips (blue weapons, purple attachments, brass ammo); gunpowder, advanced gunpowder, the ammo press module, a nine-slot gun cabinet with six looks, the chip rack expansion kit and a manual from Odin. 3D printer: a chip rack in the chip panel (swap with the arrows); purity quality on frames and print-quality pricing on finished guns; vanilla recipes on metal ingots (setting, off by default). Wild's Gunsmith card: Revolution Gunsmith, auto feed, auto stock. The Covert Operation side story. Before uninstalling or disabling: empty the chip racks and gun cabinets; if you turned on the ingot recipes, turn them off, then load and save once.
